summary_en: ROE target of 10% exceeded at 13.2% in fiscal year ended August 2026; PBR remains below 1.0x despite improvement to 0.92x. Company committed to dividend payout ratio of 30% or higher and shareholder return ratio of 3% or higher, with dividend of 155 yen per share including 60 yen special dividend for fiscal 2026.
title_en: Update on Initiatives to Realize Management that Considers Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
Akatsuki Eazima announced an update to its cost-of-capital-conscious management initiatives on 23 October 2026. The company reported that ROE for fiscal year ended August 2026 reached 13.2%, exceeding the target of 10%. However, PBR remained below 1.0x at 0.92x, indicating the stock trades at a discount despite improved profitability. The company attributes this to undervaluation by the market relative to its growth prospects.

The company declared a dividend of 155 yen per share for fiscal 2026, including a special dividend of 60 yen. Going forward, the company commits to a dividend payout ratio of 30% or higher or a shareholder return ratio (dividend yield) of 3% or higher, whichever is greater. The company also stated it will undertake share buybacks opportunistically, guided by business performance. The cost of capital is estimated at approximately 5.5-5.9%.

Initiatives to narrow the valuation gap include executing the third medium-term management plan through revenue growth and operational efficiency improvements, implementing M&A and business collaboration strategies, and enhancing investor relations disclosure of both financial and non-financial information to support appropriate corporate valuation.
